description: This file defines a Cache class responsible for managing caching operations, including storing, retrieving, and deleting cache entries, as well as handling cache directory management. It uses the system temporary directory and provides utility functions for cache directory structure and cleanup.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Provides static methods for cache management, including storing, retrieving, and deleting cache items, as well as managing cache directory structure and cleanup.

methods.name: getDirectory
methods.description: Returns the cache directory path, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a cache item with a given key and value.

methods.name: ensureCacheDirectoryExists
methods.description: Create cache directory for a specific path if it does not exist.

methods.name: forget
methods.description: Removes a cache item by key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by key.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Generates the full cache file path for a given key.

methods.name: rrmdir
methods.description: Recursively removes a directory and its contents.
